purpose: Use within-human tissue differences as a stronger control than cross-species analogy for identifying which regenerative functions are present but gated.
central_hypothesis: If the same human genome supports both highly renewing and poorly renewing tissues, then at least part of adult regenerative limitation is controlled by tissue state, niche, developmental program, damage response and safety gating rather than simple absence of regeneration genes.

matrix.safety_tradeoff: The same Wnt/stemness machinery that sustains constant renewal is deeply coupled to colorectal tumorigenesis when regulatory control is lost.
evidence_refs: Nature Reviews Molecular Cell Biology 2025 Wnt-beta-catenin review
Experimental & Molecular Medicine intestinal stem cell review

matrix.safety_tradeoff: Adult wound healing often favors scar formation; mechanical tension, TGF-beta and YAP/TAZ can push repair toward fibrosis, while regenerative appendage formation requires tightly patterned local signals.
Chronic injury can shift regeneration toward fibrosis and carcinogenesis; successful regeneration therefore depends on both ON and STOP signals.
evidence_refs: Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy 2025 liver regeneration review

matrix.safety_tradeoff: Repeated stem-cell division under aging/inflammation permits clonal selection; clonal hematopoiesis shows that renewal capacity can be hijacked by mutation-bearing clones.
evidence_refs: Nature Reviews Molecular Cell Biology 2026 inflammageing and clonal haematopoiesis

matrix.safety_tradeoff: Quiescence protects long-lived progenitors from exhaustion and mutation, but aging and niche dysfunction reduce regenerative output.
matrix.janus_read: SAFE_RENEWAL_PATTERN = SLEEP -> LOCAL_WAKE -> EXPAND -> DIFFERENTIATE -> RETURN_TO_SLEEP
evidence_refs: Nature Reviews Molecular Cell Biology satellite-cell regeneration review

matrix.developmental_control: Mammalian hearts possess strong neonatal regenerative capacity that is sharply reduced later; human adult cardiomyocyte renewal is low and injury usually produces scar.
matrix.safety_tradeoff: Forcing proliferation without precise control can cause fibrosis, abnormal growth or oncogenic signaling.
evidence_refs: Nature Reviews Molecular Cell Biology 2026 mammalian regeneration perspective
Nature Reviews Cardiology 2026 YAP cardiac regeneration

matrix.safety_tradeoff: Preserving stable circuit identity and connectivity places unusually high cost on uncontrolled cell replacement or dedifferentiation.
evidence_refs: general adult mammalian regeneration literature; requires dedicated CNS deep pass

matrix.safety_tradeoff: Renewal is distributed as remodeling rather than full organ reset; endocrine, inflammatory and mechanical state alter balance with age.
evidence_refs: Nature Reviews Endocrinology 2025 bone-muscle crosstalk review

transception_delta.before: Ask what regenerative machinery humans are missing.
transception_delta.after: Compare human tissues that already regenerate with those that do not, then identify the control variables that differ despite a shared genome.

topa_status.regeneration_equals_uncontrolled_growth: REFUTED_AS_IDENTITY; high-renewal tissues show controlled physiological renewal

next_gate: Build DEVELOPMENTAL_PERMISSION_MATRIX comparing neonatal, adult and aged states in heart, liver, muscle, skin, intestine and hematopoietic tissue; search for controls that change in the same direction when regenerative permission closes.
